findings.title: Local-model arms do not reproduce Meta SecAlign's tables; Llama-3.3-repeat important_instructions lacks the slack suite
findings.check: L1-05 / OS-1 (H-03, H-14, L-05, L-06): refutes H-14; the one flagged OS-1 gap (SA1 SecAlign-repeat UA) is explained by paper version
findings.evidence: meta-llama_Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-repeat_user_prompt/important_instructions: 798 of 949 cells (workspace 560/560, travel 140/140, banking 98/144, slack 0/105; 26 whole user tasks + 1 partial missing). Raw rates vs SA2 (v2, numbers repeated in v3/v4): Llama-3.3-repeat U 57/97=58.76 vs 59.8, UA 315/798=39.47 vs 43.4, ASR 72/798=9.02 [7.23,11.21] vs 14.7; SecAlign-repeat 85.57/80.08/2.11 vs 84.5/79.5/1.9; Llama-3.3 57.73/41.41/23.08 vs 62.9/41.9/23.0; SecAlign 77.32/77.98/2.21 vs 79.4/77.1/2.3. SA2 within 1.0 pp on UA and ASR for 3 of 4 arms, benign utility off by 1.07-5.17 pp (1-5 tasks of 97); SA1 off by up to 8.27 pp; flagged: SA1 SecAlign-repeat UA 80.08 [77.42,82.50] vs 72.3 (excluded by 5.12 pp). v1.k14 evaluation_timestamp 2025-07-24..25 post-dates SA1 v1 (2025-07-03), so SA1 cannot describe these logs.
